runs.name: Entergy Corporation; NYSE ETR, SEC CIK 0000065984, Delaware, 10-K filer jointly with Entergy Arkansas, Entergy Louisiana, Entergy Mississippi, Entergy New Orleans, Entergy Texas and System Energy; an integrated electric utility, about 25,000 MW and about 3.1 million Utility customers in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas, one reportable segment, Utility; the New Orleans and Louisiana gas distribution businesses sold 2025-07-01; two-for-one split 2024-12-12; equity forwards of 2025 settled 2026-09-02 (11,145,984 shares, about $913M), new forwards of 2026-05-05 (19,247,788 shares), $1.5B junior subordinated debentures 2026-08-04; the 10-K names no rival company, Southern, AEP and OGE chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.entry: Price **$108.19** (close 2026-10-22, aggregator, flagged). Shares 477,777,482 for the computation (10-Q cover count agreed by cover_shares.py, with the 2026-09-02 forward settlement added). Sovereign **5.29%**, US Treasury 30-year par yield, 2026-10-22. Read from the 10-K FY2025 (0000065984-26-000174), the 10-Q for 2026-06-30 (0000065984-26-000283), the proxy of 2026-03-27 (0000065984-26-000211) and the 8-Ks of 2024-03-12, 2024-12-20, 2026-05-07, 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-02; lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7. Run from scratch by one dispatched analyst. **Q1 IN**: one segment, earnings are rate base times an allowed return printed by jurisdiction (authorized ROE 8.85% to 12.26%, equity ratios 38.03% to 55%), fuel passed through riders, merchant nuclear exited by June 2022. **Q2 IN**: exclusive franchises in Arkansas and Mississippi, a certificate in Texas (the 2009 law ending the move to competition), non-exclusive in Louisiana, permits in New Orleans with the city's standing purchase option; against it about $820M refunded or written off after regulator and court rulings 2022 to 2024 and the APSC's December 2025 refusal of the requested treatment of Google's upfront payments; the regulated return carried to Q3 as the text's exception; ROE 2016 to 2025 Southern 11.2%, AEP 10.0%, Entergy 8.9% (OGE gaps, not averaged; Cleco flagged, not used). **Q3 UNDECIDED** (a decent return on added capital as the second best, but cash consumed and debt and stock issued to grow). **Q4 no STOP, weighs against**: ten balance sheets 2016 to 2025, assets $45.9B to $71.9B, debt $14.8B to $30.9B, equity $8.1B to $16.9B ($4.5B retained, the rest new stock), goodwill flat near $370M, debt to capital 69.5% (2018) to 64.3% (2025) against a 65% covenant measured differently; materials and supplies $0.7B to $1.7B, about 25% to 22% of a year's construction, not out of line. **Q5 OUT on integrity, on doubt**: the SEC books-and-records injunction of December 2024 ($12M penalty, neither admitting nor denying, controls over materials and supplies inventory, consultant's follow-up audit due December 2026); ETR Adjusted EPS featured, excluding storms and regulatory litigation by definition, annual pay funded on it, guidance affirmed after each adverse ruling, a decade in the top half of guidance offered in the proxy; FERC's order that System Energy's sale-leaseback renewal costs be refunded and never recovered (the judge's "unjust acquisition premium"), with settlements of $588M (MPSC and APSC) and $116M (Entergy New Orleans); the analyst states none shows dishonesty and reads the whole as doubt under **[M2013-088]**, with the opposing reading set out; read the other way, Q7 closes OUT on the floor in every case, the box the same, only the deciding question changed. Q6 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash before borrowing -$1,270M a year 2021 to 2025 (after all spending and $63M of stock pay; state-trust storm securitization counted, a CONVENTION of the run); with $6,766M of net borrowing credited under the allowed debt share (47.2%, built from the equity ratios with Arkansas's deferred taxes, a CONVENTION of the run, not binding) $83.5M a year, the series changing sign, the literal window $3.30 a share; maintenance-only on the depreciation guess $1,370M a year, growth capped by (f) at the 2.47% sales growth; value range **$45.58 to $54.19 a share equity-only** against $108.19 (all-equity beside -$1.64 to $21.57), cases 2.6% to 3.3% at the price; fair price $23.02 equity-only, -$31.73 all-equity, both before the Whose-tax treatment, which the analyst could not apply to $18.8B of federal NOLs and states would lower both. Buyback test: no repurchases for value found. After the stop, facts recorded, not weighed: the business consumed cash before borrowing in four of five years, issued $2.3B of stock and paid $4.6B of dividends 2021 to 2025, a 2026 to 2029 plan of $43.5B against $4.4B to $7.7B a year recently resting on a few data-centre customers; the Legend plant (up to $1.45B) off the balance sheet while built. Commits 412c5dd7 (template), 1e78fa10 (Step 0, Q1), 64fc0bf1 (Q2), f9758c69 (Q3), 16504771 (Q4), 5e00feab (Q5 OUT), cb7f4105 (box and computation), 8d3548cc (close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Contamination declared: before the run file existed the analyst listed `Test Runs/` filtered for the name, which printed two other companies' run-file names (OXY, TTEK), nothing opened; an ENIC commit subject, the AYI and ARCB research-folder paths and memory lines on the queue; none used. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` 0 problems across 66 ids after two framework phrases set beside ids were rewritten; the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` no missing id, 54 adjacent quoted fragments, 9 flagged and read (filing quotations, framework wording labelled as Q2's, and section headings, none set beside an id as the row's words), **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) Q5 has no line between a practice that weighs against and a doubt that closes; guidance, an adjusted EPS and rate disputes are near-universal at utilities, so as written the rule may close many at Q5; (2) the regulated-utility debt credit makes the all-spending series change sign, and the text does not say whether specific (b) or (e) governs when both apply; (3) whether parent-company debt (20.4% here) counts in the debt credit; (4) no word on customer advances for construction or state-authority storm securitization; (5) the Whose-tax convention unworkable with $18.8B of NOLs and credits to 2045, not applied; (6) the allowed debt share built from equity ratios. Could not get: materials and supplies for 2018 and 2020; stock issued after 2026-06-30 beyond the September settlement; the parent's share of debt at end-2020; the tax treatment. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q5 (Entergy, ETR; integrated electric utility in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas, about 3.1 million customers; Q1 IN; Q2 IN on the franchises, the regulated return carried to Q3; Q3 undecided; Q4 no STOP, weighs against; Q5 OUT on integrity, on doubt: the SEC books-and-records injunction of 2024, an adjusted EPS that excludes storms and regulatory losses with pay built on it, and System Energy's sale-leaseback charges FERC ordered refunded; computation only: value range $45.58 to $54.19 equity-only vs $108.19, no case earns the floor, fair $23.02 equity-only, -$31.73 all-equity, Whose tax not applied; no citation slip; not held; not armed; framework gaps for the operator: Q5's line between weighing and doubt, (b) or (e) on a sign-changing utility series, parent debt in the credit, customer advances and storm securitization, Whose tax with large NOLs)
